🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in top performers); confirmation: strong sector-level breadth vs concentrated tech leadership and clear megacap divergences (AAPL, GOOGL, AMD BELOW TREND while PLTR, SHOP ABOVE TREND) — two independent confirmations for CAUTION.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +3.79% | 1M: +10.58%) ABOVE TREND and CVX (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +7.94%) ABOVE TREND; Energy breadth: 8/10 positive. Technology strong on momentum names: MSFT (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND; Tech breadth: 14/24 positive. Materials rising: NEM (1W: +19.93% | 1M: +25.90%) ABOVE TREND; Materials breadth: 8/11 positive.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Real Estate weak: CCI (1W: -5.18% | 1M: -7.77%) BELOW TREND; Real Estate breadth: 3/10 positive. Utilities weak: VST (1W: -8.38% | 1M: -10.07%) BELOW TREND; Utilities breadth: 2/10 positive. Consumer Staples soft: MO (1W: -4.47% | 1M: -9.52%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Staples breadth: 4/14 positive.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +32.62% | 1M: +26.64%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +19.93% | 1M: +25.90%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +18.32%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +10.92% | 1M: +18.14%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: MO (1W: -4.47% | 1M: -9.52%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -5.18% | 1M: -7.77%) BELOW TREND, KHC (1W: -5.64% | 1M: +0.32%) CORRECTION, RCL (1W: -5.71% | 1M: +6.42%) CORRECTION, MNST (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -6.41%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in staples/real estate.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +32.62% | 1M: +26.64%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +19.93% | 1M: +25.90%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR divergence: ISRG (1W: +8.95% | 1M: -1.45%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +0.79% | 1M: -11.10%) RECOVERY, TSLA (1W: +1.67% | 1M: -15.69%) RECOVERY — tactical volatility, watch for trend break.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed internals with concentrated winners and several lagging megacaps; MSFT (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND contrast with AAPL (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -8.96% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND; Tech breadth: 14/24 positive — rotation inside the sector.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft on the week overall but some leaders remain ABOVE TREND: JPM (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND while sector 1W is marginally negative; Financials breadth: 9/20 positive — mixed/call it style mixed given narrow tech leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive names mixed with pockets of strength: LLY (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +10.64%) ABOVE TREND, but UNH (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -6.27%) BELOW TREND and CVS (1W: -10.46% | 1M: -11.16%) BELOW TREND; Healthcare breadth: 11/17 positive — sector support but headline risk from regulatory headlines.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Energy and selective Technology winners (MSFT, NVDA) and Materials (NEM, MPC) while reducing exposure to the weakest staples/real estate names such as MO and CCI; style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow top-performer concentration and cross-sector breadth.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PLTR (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +32.62% | 1M: +26.64%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND — momentum and sentiment confirmed. BEARISH: CVS (1W: -10.46% | 1M: -11.16%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -8.96% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -8.53% | 1M: -11.24%) BELOW TREND — these show distribution and headline risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (XOM, CVX) — Sector breadth: 8/10 positive. BEARISH: Real Estate and Utilities — Real Estate breadth: 3/10 positive; Utilities breadth: 2/10 positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
MSFT (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND — watch continuation above recent highs for momentum confirmation; NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND — watch 1M uptrend hold; AAPL (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND — monitor for failure to reclaim 1M trend.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+60): Eli Lilly scores weight-loss drug win; LLY (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. MA (+55): Services rev jump; MA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +4.42%) CORRECTION — sentiment positive but short-term pullback. MRK (+80) noted in news but not in the provided returns table so omitted from stock-level commentary.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CVS (-60): Political/regulatory headlines; CVS (1W: -10.46% | 1M: -11.16%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and acute. NVDA (-50): Critical headlines on financing; NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging from price, monitor for distribution. UNH (-55): Political headlines; UNH (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -6.27%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration amid positive sector breadth. PLTR, SHOP, NEM ABOVE TREND while AAPL, GOOGL, CVS showing weakness. Key risk: major short-term divergences (META, ISRG, TSLA RECOVERY and NVDA sentiment divergence) — monitor for trend breaks.
